addr: 9800 S Sepulveda Blvd, Los Angeles, CA

shots.name: lax_sepulveda_street
shots.pos: const M = en.sky.model, a = M.airports.LAX, e = M.runway('LAX', '24R'); return M.along(a, e, e.displ - 700, 260);
shots.check: const k = en.sky, f = k.flights.filter(p => p.kind === 'arr' && p.f.rw === '24R' && p.dist > 0).sort((a, b) => a.dist - b.dist)[0]; return f ? { nearest24R_nm: +(f.dist / 1852).toFixed(2), y_m: +f.y.toFixed(1), want_m: +((55 * 0.3048) + Math.tan(3 * Math.PI / 180) * f.dist).toFixed(1), type: f.f.type.key } : null;

shots.name: lax_drone_east
shots.pos: const M = en.sky.model, a = M.airports.LAX, e = M.runway('LAX', '24R'); return M.along(a, e, e.displ + 300, 500);

shots.name: coronado_bridge_tidelands
shots.check: const d = en.sky.decks[0], K = d.loc.K, t = en.sky.tools, p = t.pointAt(d, K.ch); return { channel_s: Math.round(K.ch), L: Math.round(d.loc.L), deck_at_channel: +t.deckY(d, K.ch, p.x, p.z).toFixed(1), deckAt: en.world.deckAt(p.x, p.z), off: en.world.deckAt(p.x + 200, p.z + 200) };

shots.name: golden_gate_crissy
shots.check: const d = en.sky.decks.find(x => x.name === 'Golden Gate Bridge'), K = d.loc.K, t = en.sky.tools, p = t.pointAt(d, (K.S + K.N) / 2); return { towers_m: Math.round(K.N - K.S), mid_deck: +t.deckY(d, (K.S + K.N) / 2, p.x, p.z).toFixed(1), deckAt: en.world.deckAt(p.x, p.z) };
